edit.description: read_lockfile walks to the workspace-root lock and reads every pnpm document

summary: A package-bin tool's version is read from the lockfile the package manager actually wrote: a workspace-root lock above the program, and a pnpm lock past its env document
acceptance: neither a workspace-root lockfile nor a multi-document pnpm lock draws tool.unlocked for a locked package
tests: a workspace root lockfile above the program locks a package bin tool
a pnpm lockfile with a leading env document locks a package bin tool
notes: Note TOOL-PACKAGE-BIN-READS-THE-LOCKFILE: read only from the workspace dir; gray_matter reads only the first YAML document. The pnpm 10 configDependencies env document is the note's claim, UNVERIFIED: cite pnpm docs before encoding it, else drop that line and raise.
